data.name: BeginYourDutchJourneyParagraph
data.value: Ready to dive into Dutch culture, connect with locals, and unlock new opportunities? Whether you've just arrived or you're aiming to deepen your roots here, mastering Dutch is your gateway. From acing your integration exams to feeling at home in The Netherlands, we've got your back. Join us and start speaking Dutch with confidence today!

data.name: ContentSectionParagraph1
data.value: Life's challenges—be it at work, in relationships, or within ourselves—signal growth and development. It's common to face hurdles, and while some may resolve on their own, others benefit from additional support, whether through listening or training, to find your way again.

data.name: ContentSectionParagraph2
data.value: We've navigated numerous obstacles, from career dissatisfaction and setbacks to personal and interpersonal issues. Our aim is to spare you the lengthy, tough journey. Leveraging our vast experience, we're committed to identifying and tailoring solutions that best suit your unique circumstances, ensuring you feel aligned and fulfilled.

data.name: HeroParagraph
data.value: Navigate life's challenges with our expert guidance. From professional setbacks to personal growth, we offer the listening ear, support, and tailored solutions you need to thrive in every aspect of life. Let us help you find your way back to yourself and achieve the growth you're destined for.

data.name: MoreInfoParagraph
data.value: Discover how our tailored guidance can help you achieve your goals with a free 30-minute consultation.

data.name: TopicsSectionParagraph
data.value: Speak to a professional and start your journey to self-improvement.

data.name: SeoTitle
data.value: Personal Development & Coaching | iD! Training & Development

data.name: MetaDescription
data.value: Personal development and coaching for when you're ready to reconnect with yourself, make a change, or find your own way forward.

data.name: HeroTitle
data.value: For when “is this really it?” keeps circling in your head

data.name: HeroDescription
data.value: You might recognize the feeling: from the outside, everything checks out. A job, a home, maybe a family, plans every weekend. And yet something keeps nagging. A sense that you see the world just a little differently from the people around you, or that somewhere along the way, you've lost a piece of yourself.

data.name: HeroNoteDescription
data.value: Not as people with all the answers, but as guides who've lost our own way once or twice too, and who use that experience to help you find yourself again.

data.name: ApproachParagraph1
data.value: We're not coaches who lean back and hum along — so we'd rather not give ourselves that title. We think with you, reflect, ask the question you're avoiding, and laugh with you along the way. No heroes on a pedestal, but people with real-life experience and a sharp eye for blind spots.

data.name: ApproachParagraph2
data.value: We've both turned our lives upside down more than once: sometimes by choice, sometimes because we had no other option. We know what it's like to make big decisions without knowing where they'll lead. We use that experience to help you get to your own answers faster.

data.name: AudienceDescription
data.value: For people who are curious about themselves and the world, who have a sense of humour — including about their own struggles — and who understand that growth can feel uncomfortable before it brings relief.

data.name: HelpEyebrow
data.value: What we can help you with

data.name: HelpItem1
data.value: Setting boundaries without it feeling like a fight

data.name: HelpItem3
data.value: Dealing with conflict and difficult conversations

data.name: HelpItem5
data.value: Big choices: emigrating, changing jobs, starting a different life

data.name: HelpItem7
data.value: Leadership from who you are, not who you think you should be

data.name: Method1Description
data.value: You, one of us, and a conversation without judgment. Sometimes you need a sounding board; sometimes someone needs to hold a mirror up to you. Often, both.

data.name: Method2Description
data.value: For two (or more) people who keep getting stuck together. We help make the conversation possible again — honestly, safely, and with room for everyone's perspective.

data.name: Method3Description
data.value: For smaller groups, around themes such as assertiveness, self-confidence, communication, or leadership. Always practical, always personal.

data.name: Method4Description
data.value: For teams that want to work better together. See Organizations for more information.

data.name: MethodsConclusion
data.value: The first conversation is free. We listen to what is going on, what you need, and whether we are the right people for you. Everything is tailor-made, and we agree on the price after that conversation.
